intro: Every skill, MCP server, Hook, plugin and command-line tool this target resolves, including copies that are overridden. Same-name skills: built-in copies win over plugin copies unless you select the plugin version; project, external-directory and user skills always win.
appliesToNewConversations: Changes apply to new conversations. Running conversations keep the skills they started with.
empty: No extensions found on this target.
unsupported: This target does not report duplicates and overrides yet. Upgrade KCoder on the target to use the All and Conflicts views.

notice.preference_conflict: The skill preference was changed elsewhere. The latest state has been loaded; review it and choose again.
notice.skill_switch_conflict: This plugin's skill setting was changed elsewhere. The latest state has been loaded; review it and choose again.
notice.unconfirmed: The save could not be confirmed. The latest state has been loaded; check it before trying again.
notice.unavailable: Extension information could not be loaded from this target. Try refreshing.
notice.scope_changed: The target or account changed. Refresh to load the current target.
notice.unsupported: This target does not support this action. Upgrade KCoder on the target.

detail.differentUpstream: Upstream differs or is not declared

preferenceBlocked: Project, external-directory and user skills always win over plugin copies; this cannot be changed here.
preferredByPlugin: Selected because all skills of {{plugin}} are preferred.
pluginSkillSwitchLimit: This target can only turn off a plugin's skills together with the whole plugin. Upgrade KCoder on the target to turn off only the skills, or turn off the plugin under Plugins.

pluginSkills.help: Turning this off removes only this plugin's skill copies. Other copies of the same skills, and the plugin's MCP servers and Hooks, stay as they are.
pluginSkills.helpOff: This plugin's skills are off. Same-name skills from other sources are used instead; the plugin's MCP servers and Hooks are unaffected.

binaries.title: Command-line tools
binaries.description: Looks for lark-cli, node and playwright-mcp on the target's PATH and runs a short version check. Only runs when you ask.
binaries.checked: Showing the result of the last check.

summary.same_name_one: {{name}}: {{effective}} is in use; {{count}} other copy is overridden.
summary.same_name_other: {{name}}: {{effective}} is in use; {{count}} other copies are overridden.
summary.mixed_family: {{name}}-* mixes sources: {{plugin}} provides {{provided}}, of which {{fromPlugin}} are in use; {{missing}} come only from the built-in set.
summary.multiple_binaries_one: {{name}}: {{effective}} is used; {{count}} other copy on PATH is ignored.
summary.multiple_binaries_other: {{name}}: {{effective}} is used; {{count}} other copies on PATH are ignored.
summary.version_mismatch: {{name}} {{resolved}} on PATH differs from the bundled {{bundled}}; skills may expect different commands.

hookIssues.errorHelp: A rule with an error blocks its event until the configuration is fixed. Start a new conversation after fixing it.
